dedupe_keys.name: combined green infrastructure corridors the conservation fund midwest wind and nisource hcps

description: This layer combines core habitat and corridor areas of a green infrastructure network to show where projects could improve functional connectivity of the landscape. The Conservation Fund generated it in the network design for two habitat conservation plans tied to energy infrastructure, the Midwest Wind Energy Multi-Species Habitat Conservation Plan and the NiSource pipeline plan; Michael Schwartz uploaded it to Data Basin in September 2015, with the data hosted by USGS ScienceBase. Tags link it to landscape conservation design in the Mississippi River basin. Coverage is the US Midwest planning area. Format and access: an external ArcGIS map service with FGDC metadata; Data Basin reported the service as unavailable when read. Licence: CC-BY-3.0; free. Caveats: content date and resolution are not specified, and the service may no longer respond. It helps route and site wind farms and pipelines around habitat corridors, a planning question for energy infrastructure. Related catalogue records are the LUIGI Alpine green infrastructure maps and the Natural England green infrastructure mapping database.
